title: Diophantine Obstructions, Degree-120 S-Unit Descent, and Affine Orthogonal Runge Theorems for Multiplicity Five in Pascal's Triangle
field: Diophantine equations and algebraic number theory
decided_scope: Unconditional omega(a) >= 7, K(a) >= 8, and omega(a) >= 14 on {5,6,7,8}, degree-120 2-adic Selmer descent, and sharp global Runge obstruction for affine orthogonal pole fibers G_g = F_2^(2g) semidirect O^+_(2g)(2)
open_boundaries: Complete classification of all integers appearing at least five times in Pascal's triangle
